relations.rationale: The hiking trip's start time has no bearing on who the head judge is.
The trip's start time is unrelated to Eli's height being useful for spotting markers.
The trip starting at the trailhead sets up the context for the described trail continuing from that start point.
Esme arriving first has no connection to who is the head judge.
Esme arriving first before others directly supports the claim that Dara arrived a few minutes after her.
Esme arriving first is consistent with and supports the idea that someone else, Jun, arrived last.
Esme's arrival order has nothing to do with the number of teams.
Esme arriving first in the morning is unrelated to the group settling into tents by evening.
Esme's early arrival has no bearing on the group's end-of-day satisfaction.
Esme carrying a bright orange backpack directly supports the claim that it made her easy to spot.
Esme's backpack visibility is unrelated to when Dara arrived.
Esme's backpack visibility has no connection to Yara bringing the first-aid kit.
Esme's backpack being visible is unrelated to whether she and Dara were on different teams.
Jun being the head judge has no bearing on Yara bringing the first-aid kit.
Jun being head judge is unrelated to whether Jun made it before the group set off.
Being head judge does not imply or preclude being the oldest of the group.
Jun being head judge could plausibly explain Jun setting the pace, suggesting a leadership role that others follow.
Jun's role as head judge is unrelated to whether Esme and Eli were on different teams.
Dara arriving a few minutes late after jogging supports the detail that she was out of breath from jogging the last stretch.
Dara's late arrival is unrelated to Eli's height being useful for spotting trail markers.
